change.after: "Kafka resource as regardingObject, Pod in related"

consequence.statement: Consumers of Kubernetes events emitted during a Pod restart will see the Kafka resource referenced as the regardingObject and the Pod in the related field, instead of the previous field population; tooling that relied on the old layout should be reviewed.

assertion.statement: In Strimzi 0.46.0, the Kubernetes events emitted during a Pod restart were updated so that the Kafka resource is set as the regardingObject and the Pod appears in the related field.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The change affects the content of events emitted at runtime during a Pod restart; no static environment input shows whether these events occur or are consumed, so exposure cannot be expressed as a configuration predicate.
